description: PREFERRED for official docs: resolve a library/package name to a Context7 library ID (e.g. /vercel/next.js). Use this (then queryDocs) FIRST when the task needs official library/framework documentation — more reliable than web search and works without a proxy.

libraryName.description: The library or package name to search for (e.g. 'Next.js', 'express', 'prisma')

limit.description: Maximum number of library matches to return (default 5)

query.description: The user's question or task, used to rank results by relevance (optional; defaults to the library name when omitted, e.g. 'how to implement authentication')

name: resolveLibraryId
